hook: Ben goes to the gym now. Anna asks him about before and after.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Before you joined the gym, what did you do?

translation.vi: Trước khi bạn bắt đầu đi gym, bạn làm gì?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I sat a lot. After I joined the gym, my body feels good every week.

translation.vi: Mình ngồi nhiều. Sau khi mình bắt đầu đi gym, cơ thể mình thấy khỏe mỗi tuần.

gloss.en: a place where you go to exercise
the part of you that has arms, legs, and a head

grammar_notes: Use 'before' or 'after' + subject + verb to say when something happens. Example: 'Before I joined the gym, I sat a lot.'
interaction_prompts: Do you have a new hobby? What do you do before or after it?
